text:
maria_cs: Citrine Logistics asked to onboard a custom summarizer for order manifests. They flagged PHI handling, require HSM/KMS, and want a 99.9% uptime SLA. Also strict latency target: <=250ms p95. Can CS + Eng sync on what we need to intake?

devon_se: looping eng-ml in my head. quick Q — is this a fine-tuned Llama-family variant or custom arch? we'll need model artifact, tokenizer, and a perf profile (seq len distribution, typical max tokens). If context > 16k we might hit perf issues.

katie_success: I can run enablement. Action items from our side: collect sample prompts, define success criteria (precision/recall or rouge?) and get an eval set. Also mark this as renewal-risky — they mentioned SLA tied to a 2yr renewal.

simon_ops: For PHI + HSM we should default to Private deployment (VPC + customer KMS/HSM). From capacity perspective: estimate is 4 concurrent low-latency streams. Preliminary infra suggestion: Dedicated pool equivalent to 2xH100 or 4xA100 with colocated batching. Need infra contact + KMS ARN.

onboard-bot: Checklist created for thread 1767777001 — 1) model artifact + tokenizer 2) eval dataset 3) security questionnaire (signed) 4) infra contact + KMS info 5) billing PO / SLA appendix. Docs: https://app.redwood.ai/docs/private-deploy (internal)

maria_cs: I'll push artifacts and customer eval rubric by EOD. They want a staging dry-run next Tue. Also note prior feedback: they reported latency spikes during peak hours and poor alerting granularity — capture for runbook.

devon_se: to help Eng-ml, sending minimal requested config they expect us to support:

```json
{
  "model": "citrine-summarizer-14b-ft",
  "context": 8192,
  "quant": "int8",
  "max_tokens": 512
}
```

katie_success: I'll draft a one-pager and runbook: onboarding cadence = canary (1%), smoke tests, perf ramp, signoff. Need Eng to confirm perf targets and fallback behavior (cheaper variant).

simon_ops: Perf notes: achieving p95 <=250ms for 512 tokens implies KV prefix caching + low-batching strategy. We should propose an automatic fallback to a quantized variant (e.g., 8-bit) when latency or queue depth spikes. Also include routing policy to fallback region.

priya_pm: Account health: current CES is 3.2 (threshold 3.0). This is a watch item for renewal. Recommend prioritizing enablement and an executive check-in post-dry-run. Also plan an NPS / feedback capture after staging run.

maria_cs: copying next steps: 1) I upload artifacts + eval set by EOD. 2) Katie to schedule enablement call (this week). 3) Simon to validate infra sketch and share capacity estimate. 4) Devon to confirm model compatibility & quantization plan. I'll update the thread with customer's runbook acceptance. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

katie_success: scheduling now — sending calendar invite to Citrine + Eng leads.

simon_ops: starting infra sizing ticket and will post estimate (ETA today).

devon_se: will review artifact when it lands. if we need any model conversion steps I'll note them in thread.

maria_cs: uploaded prompts + eval rubric (link in customer workspace). tagging when ready for review. :heart:
